## What this is

`gangtise-private` is a local Agent Skill. Read personal Gangtise terminal data: stock pools, WeChat groups, meetings, recordings, and AI cloud drive; export CSV/Markdown.

**Keywords**: `自选股池`, `微信群消息`, `我的会议`, `录音速记`, `AI 云盘`, `私有数据`, `gangtise private`

## Install

1. Download: [gangtise-private.zip](https://gts-download.obs.cn-east-3.myhuaweicloud.com/skills/gangtise-private.zip)
2. Unzip to get `gangtise-private/`, copy it into your `skills/` directory
3. Follow `SKILL.md` for runtime setup (install deps if listed)

Configure `GTS_ACCESS_KEY` / `GTS_SECRET_KEY` from the [open platform](https://open-platform.gangtise.com/), or follow the skill’s auth file instructions.

## Example prompts

- 我终端里「自选股1」这个池子有哪些票？
- 我名下所有自选股池列一下，我想核对有没有漏加。
- 指定几个股票池里的成分股名单导出来。
- AI学习群里上个月聊半导体的消息帮我翻一下。
- 我常用的几个微信群分别是哪几个，群名对一下。
